D: An astronaut left for dead on Mars has to survive alone until anyone can reach him.
P: Serve the snacks when Mark harvests his first potato crop in the Hab.
S: Baked potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives
Potatoes baked at 200C for an hour, scooped out, brushed with butter, filled with cheddar and bacon and baked again until crisp, sour cream and chives on top.
Roasted red pepper hummus with smoked paprika and warm flatbread
Roasted red capsicum blitzed with chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon and smoked paprika until smooth, swirled with olive oil, served with warm flatbread.
counting out the crew's food packs to make them last

Almonds, cashews, oats and pepitas roasted in honey and cinnamon, set into crunchy clusters with dried apricot and dark chocolate, one bag per sol. Mix 100g almonds, 100g cashews, 100g rolled oats and 50g pepitas. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 30g butter and half a tsp cinnamon, pour over and toss well. Press onto a lined tray and bake at 160C for 20 minutes until golden. Cool completely, then break into clusters. Toss with 100g chopped dried apricots and 80g dark chocolate chunks and bag up.
M: Creamy potato and leek soup topped with crisp bacon and chives
Leeks and onion softened in butter, potatoes and chicken stock simmered 25 minutes, blended silky with cream, topped with crisp bacon and chives, crusty bread alongside.
Hermes lemon chicken with roast pumpkin
the Hermes crew turning around to go back for him

Brined chicken breasts roasted with garlic and lemon, sliced over a warm salad of roast pumpkin, baby spinach, feta and toasted pepitas with honey mustard dressing. Brine 4 chicken breasts in 1L water with 50g salt for 1 hour, then pat dry. Roast 800g pumpkin chunks in oil at 200C for 30 minutes. Rub the chicken with oil, garlic and lemon zest and roast at 200C for 20 minutes to 74C inside, then rest. Toss the pumpkin with 100g spinach, 100g feta and toasted pepitas. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, mustard and honey and dress. Slice the chicken over.
W: Vanilla ice cream, fudge sauce, a whipped cream rocket and crushed honeycomb

Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge, whipped cream piped into a tall rocket shape, crushed honeycomb at the base for the flames. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses and pour over the fudge. Pipe whipped cream into a tall rocket shape and scatter crushed honeycomb at the base for flames.
K: Lewis's disco condensed milk iced coffee
Strong coffee sweetened with condensed milk, chilled over ice

Strong drip coffee poured hot over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and chilled, then served over ice with a splash of cold milk. Brew 800ml strong coffee from 60g ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of four heatproof glasses. Pour 200ml hot coffee into each and stir until the condensed milk dissolves. Cool, then chill for 30 minutes. Add plenty of ice and top with a splash of cold milk. Stir once and serve with a straw.

s.note: Baked potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives
s.how: Bake 800g large potatoes at 200C for an hour. Halve, scoop and brush with 40g butter. Fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake until crisp. Top with sour cream and chives. Grown with care.

s.note: Roasted red pepper hummus with smoked paprika and warm flatbread
s.how: Roast a red capsicum until black, peel and seed. Blitz with a tin of chickpeas, 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice and 1 tsp smoked paprika until smooth. Swirl with olive oil and serve with warm flatbread.

m.note: Creamy potato and leek soup topped with crisp bacon and chives
m.how: Soften 2 leeks and an onion in 40g butter. Add 800g potatoes and 1.2L stock and simmer 25 minutes. Blend with 150ml cream until silky. Top with 150g crisp bacon and chives and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream, fudge sauce, a whipped cream rocket and crushed honeycomb
